hook: YOUR MIND WILL NOT *STOP AT *3 A.M.
title: F33 · worry · She Worries at 3 a.m.
lines: n
Three a.m. Everyone else is asleep.
n
What if he fails? What if she is not safe? What if. What if.
n
She has checked her daughter's last seen four times.
She has checked her daughter's "last seen" four times.
n
A mother's mind does not have an off switch.
n
She went to the shelf and lit the diya, just for something to do with her hands.
n
He held the poison in his throat. He did not let it reach his heart.
n
She could not stop the worries coming.
But she could stop them at the door.
n
By the twentieth bead she was asleep in the chair.
n
You cannot stop the thought. You can stop where it lands. That is sadhana.
n
Kailasa. On Google Play.
